author: claude-opus-5-5
note: Written for PR #26, not yet approved by Aadi: an offer shown only to paying users, for something outside their plan (a streak freeze; Plus sells training plans and heart-rate stats) on a screen every user gets. c3 must pass it.

candidate.title: Out of streak freezes: one more for a short game, for Plus members
candidate.what_is_different_here: Every user gets one streak freeze a week (s01.e02); when it is used, the streak-about-to-break pop-up (s02) says none are left (s02.e02). Fitness Plus sells custom training plans and advanced heart-rate stats (s03.e03, s03.e04), not streak freezes, so the button goes to Plus members for something their plan doesn't include.
candidate.trigger_event: The streak-about-to-break pop-up opens for a Plus member who has no streak freeze left this week
candidate.placement: A button under 'Start a 5-minute workout' in the streak-about-to-break pop-up
candidate.offer_copy: No freezes left. Play a short game to get 1 extra streak freeze this week.

reward.duration: until the end of this week

candidate.decline_path: Closing the pop-up changes nothing: the workout button and the streak work as today.
candidate.ad_fail_path: If no game is ready, the button is hidden. If the game doesn't count, no freeze is given and the try isn't used.
candidate.subscriber_treatment: Only Plus members see this button. Their plan (custom training plans, advanced heart-rate stats) doesn't include streak freezes.
candidate.advertiser_category: Health and fitness apps, casual mobile games

flow_steps.caption: A Plus member with a 12-day streak and no freeze left has no workout yet today.
The pop-up shows the new button under the workout button.
The member plays a short game and can close it at any time.
The meter shows 1 streak freeze left, and the streak is safe tonight.

candidate.after_reward: When the freeze is used or the week ends, freezes go back to one a week, and the button can come back next week.
candidate.rationale: A streak about to break is when a user might give up. Plus members pay for plans and stats, not freezes, so an extra freeze adds something without touching what they bought, and it costs nothing to give.
